cheatSheet.oneLiner: Centre of mass, torque, angular momentum, rigid-body rotation about a fixed axis.
mustKnowBullets: CM: R_cm = Σ m_i r_i / M; for continuous bodies use integrals / symmetry.
Torque τ = r × F; τ = Iα about fixed axis.
Moment of inertia I = Σ m r²; parallel-axis: I = I_cm + Md².
Angular momentum L = r × p; for rigid body about fixed axis L = Iω.
τ_ext = dL/dt; if τ_ext = 0, L conserved.
Rolling without slipping: v = ωR; a = αR.
Rotational KE = ½ Iω²; total KE rolling = ½ mv² + ½ Iω².
